versions.changelog: v2.0.0: 两层架构重写。采集层：运行按书籍/运行ID隔离、OCR缓存键绑定图片SHA-256、采集前自动回退书首并记录起止位置与停止原因、画面签名改真实哈希、不再默认删除中间材料。新增纯离线重建层：官方章节骨架+顺序指针分章+证据化拼接（包含/重叠/页序连续，备选片段保留附录不静默丢弃）、段落级溯源source_map.json、质量报告含完整性声明。已用52章真实书数据回归验证：与基准输出52/52章状态一致、字数差0.0%。

- Initial release of weread-fulltext: export full text of WeRead books as Markdown.
- Supports canvas-protected books (common for new books published after 2026) via large viewport canvas sweep and local OCR.
- Designed for maximum account safety: read-only, natural page-turning delays, native page turn, and fully local OCR (no external text transmission).
- Outputs by chapter with word count integrity checks; suitable for AI knowledge bases, RAG, citation search, and note archiving.
- Simple command-line usage, with options for headless mode, spread limit, and keeping intermediate images.
